S01.title: Sign in
S01.note: Michael gets in. The car expects him and signs him in by face. PIN or password is the fallback.

hotspots.label: Not Michael? Switch profile
hotspots.toast: Another profile would sign in here. Not drawn in this prototype.

S02.title: Welcome
S02.note: The car is already moving towards home, the most likely destination. Maya greets him.
S02.maya: Hi, I’m Maya, your concierge for the trip. How can I assist you?

cta.label: Speak to Maya
cta.say: Hi Maya. Family dinner tonight. Let’s get the kids and my wife, and I need that new prescription from my messages as soon as possible.

S03.title: Maya’s access
S03.note: Opened from Adjust. Michael chooses what Maya may do on her own. Tap the map to close.

S04.title: Briefing: listening
S04.note: The New plan card fills in as Michael talks. Voice and touch are both open.

cta.label: Answer Maya
cta.say: The usual Italian on Main Street. Seven.

S05.title: Briefing: keyboard
S05.note: Touch twin. Maya’s bar becomes a text field and the keyboard rises. There is no mic button.

S06.title: Briefing: Maya asks
S06.note: Maya asks only what she can’t know: where, then when. The search field is the touch twin, with no suggested answers.

cta.label: Answer by voice
cta.say: The usual Italian on Main Street. Seven.

S07.title: Briefing: building the plan
S07.note: This is what Maya understood. Every detail is still editable while the plan is built. Maya does not read it back.

S08.title: Pharmacy search
S08.note: Screen only. Maya calls pharmacies on the route, nearest first, with a live transcript. The first has no stock; the second does, and she pays.

branches.label: What if no pharmacy on the route has stock?

S09.title: Plan updated (automatic)
S09.note: The world changed, so Maya changes the plan silently and visibly. Pharmacy 1 is gone, pharmacy 2 is new, spare time is still +5 min.

S10.title: Gift suggestion
S10.note: It is a birthday dinner, so Maya suggests flowers once the pharmacy is secure.
S10.maya: It’s a birthday dinner. Would you like flowers waiting at the restaurant before we arrive?

hotspots.label: No thanks
hotspots.toast: No flowers. The plan carries on without them.

S11.title: Florist order
S11.note: With Maya silent: called, delivery agreed, payment successful, delivery committed. The florist delivers to the restaurant, so there is no extra stop.

S12.title: Plan overview
S12.note: No speech. The Going home route is replaced by the full plan. Spare time +5 min. The car never stops moving.

S13.title: Vehicle intent
S13.note: Before each stop the screen says what the car is about to do: where it pulls in, which doors unlock, how long it waits.

S14.title: Active trip
S14.note: Son on board. Maya says nothing. The ledger shows what was done for him, with Undo on the latest row.

hotspots.label: Undo
hotspots.toast: Undo would reverse the flowers order. Not drawn in this prototype.

branches.label: What if spare time runs out?
What if a child says “let’s go to the park”?

S15.title: Edit plan
S15.note: Touch twin for changing the plan. Drag to reorder; the ripple preview shows the effect on every later stop before Apply.

hotspots.label: Apply
hotspots.toast: Applied. In the full product the plan would update.

S16.title: Incoming call
S16.note: The wife calls. The call is the only overlay, and it stays small.

S17.title: Plan updated (ambient)
S17.note: Wife: “Change of plan: pick me up at the hair salon, not at home.” Maya hears it and changes the pickup with no spoken line. A soft chime sounds; Undo has no countdown.

hotspots.label: Undo
hotspots.toast: Undo restores the home pickup. Not drawn in this prototype.

branches.label: What if Michael misses the chime?

S18.title: Errand suggestion
S18.note: The dry cleaner’s message arrives; Maya doesn’t read it aloud. She offers to collect the suit with the empty car after the drop-off.
S18.maya: Your suit is ready at the dry cleaner. After I drop you at the restaurant, I can collect it on my own and wait nearby until you call. Shall I?

hotspots.label: No thanks
hotspots.toast: No thanks. Maya drops the errand. Not drawn in this prototype.

S19.title: Errand booked
S19.note: With Maya silent: the call, payment and agreed handover (19:20, rear right door, on a hanger, code sent). Only now is the errand booked: no handoff, no commitment.

S20.title: Arrival report
S20.note: Arrived on time with 5 minutes to spare, and the full list of what was done. Next is the courier run; then the car waits nearby until Michael calls it.
S20.maya: We’re here, five minutes early. I’ll collect your suit and wait nearby until you call.

C1.title: Leaving in courier mode
C1.note: Please take your belongings. Once everyone is out, the car checks that the cabin is empty and nothing is left behind, then drives off.
C1.maya: Leaving in courier mode. Please take your belongings.

C2.title: Phone: courier run
C2.note: Nobody is in the cabin, so the central display and Panoramic Vision are off and there is no voice. Michael follows the run on his phone, in the My BMW app, view only.

C3.title: Phone: errand report
C3.note: A notification, no voice: a photo of the suit on the hanger, the receipt and the times. The car then charges near the restaurant and waits until Michael calls it. The story ends here.

C4.title: Errands
C4.note: Opened by the box icon beside Settings: upcoming, running and done errands.

C5.title: New errand
C5.note: Schedule an errand by hand: what, where, when, handover, payment, and what happens if it fails.

V2.title: Edge case 2 · Running late
V2.note: Spare time has gone negative. Maya offers fixes, cheapest first. Panoramic Vision turns red.

hotspots.label: Do it: hold the table
hotspots.toast: Maya calls the restaurant to hold the table.

hotspots.label: Do it: ask wife to wait

E1.title: Edge case 1 · No stock on the route
E1.note: Maya widens the search and shows it on screen. She asks only because the detour would eat most of the spare time.

E3.title: Edge case 3 · Ambient false positive
E3.note: A child says “let’s go to the park”. Maya acts only on high confidence; otherwise she asks. Nothing has changed yet.

hotspots.label: Add stop
hotspots.toast: A stop at the park would be added.

E4.title: Edge case 4 · The chime is missed
E4.note: Michael didn’t notice the chime. The change stays on screen until he dismisses it, it stays in the ledger, and Panoramic Vision repeats it once.

hotspots.label: Undo
hotspots.toast: Undo restores the home pickup. Not drawn in this prototype.
